entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:67049
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12138 of 2024

Applicant :- Dheeraj
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Shikhar Awasthi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Shikhar Awasthi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned Brief Holder for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.93 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. and Sections 6/10 U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998, Police Station Shahganj, District Agra, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

entities.text: U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. FIR of the present case was lodged against Amit Kumar and Sumit Kumar and according to the FIR, Amit Kumar was appearing in police recruitment examination in place of Sumit Kumar.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that however FIR of the present case was lodged against Amit Kumar and Sumit Kumar but when the statement of the informant was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. then he stated that applicant disclosed his name as Amit Kumar and he was the person, who was giving examination in place of Sumit Kumar.
Dheeraj vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64187169/
1 5.
He furthe submits that entire allegation made against applicant is false and applicant never appeared in the examination in place of Sumit Kumar.

6. He further submits that applicant only had gone alongwith Sumit Kumar till examination center and at the examination center some dispute of applicant arose with the authorities concerned and thereafter on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
7. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history to his credit and he is in jail in the present matter since 19.02.2024.

8. Per contra, learned Brief Holder opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submits that applicant tried to pollute the recruitment of examination system, which is now a days very common and therefore, considering the nature of allegation and the fact that applicant is in jail only since February, 2024, he should not be released on bail.
9.
I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.
10. As per allegation, applicant appeared in police recruitment examination in place of another accused, therefore, it cannot be said that allegations against him are not serious in nature.
11. Further, applicant was arrested red handed in presence of Static Magistrate, therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said that he has been falsely implicated in the present matter.
12. Further, applicant is in jail in the present matter only since 19.02.2024.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail at this stage.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application filed on behalf of the applicant - Dheeraj is dismissed at this stage.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Zafar  Dheeraj vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64187169/
